Unknown - Description | The Digital Rollout Manager project involved developing a web application to streamline the management of various measures within Deutsche Telekom's telecommunication network rollout.

This initiative was prompted by the intricacies of DT's internal processes, IT infrastructure, and the multitude of stakeholders involved, necessitating the efficient handling of extensive and diverse datasets.
Previously, DT relied on Excel files and a labor-intensive communication loop.
The challenge lay in maintaining and managing hardware installations and configurations through these spreadsheets, which was time-consuming.
Furthermore, the communication between rollout managers and steering managers for order management involved travel and phone calls, resulting in significant difficulty.
With the introduction of DRM (Digital Rollout Manager), the situation improved.
This web application empowered rollout managers to oversee their orders through an intuitive interface, eliminating the need for manual upkeep of Excel sheets that consumed valuable time.
DRM proved to be a game-changer, allowing DT employees and stakeholders to collaborate seamlessly in the management of rollout processes..

projects: Description: MaPS is an enterprise-level application used by Baker Hughes to support drilling operations for oil and gas extraction. The system monitors and manages drilling activities both underwater and on land, helping to determine optimal drilling speeds, locations, and configurations. The application is deployed across multiple countries, supporting real-time decision-making for oil and gas exploration.
